Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notification when injuries result from health care.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to injuries resulting from health care; adding anew section to chapter 7.70 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter70.41 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every health care provider shall inform each patient, or anindividual identified pursuant to RCW 7.70.065(1), in person aboutadverse incidents that result in serious harm to the patient.Notification of outcomes of care that result in harm to the patientunder this section shall not constitute an acknowledgement or admissionof liability, nor can such notifications be introduced as evidence.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An appropriately trained person designated by each hospital shallinform each patient, or an individual identified pursuant to RCW7.70.065(1), in person about adverse incidents that result in seriousharm to the patient. Notification of outcomes of care that result in p. 1 SB 6209harm to the patient under this section shall not constitute anacknowledgement or admission of liability, nor can it be introduced asevidence.
